work.name: Multiply Labs
highlights: Developed force- and terrain-aware whole-body humanoid controllers for BRACE, adapting motion references to external loads and sloped terrain (under review).

work.name: General Robotics
highlights: Developed robot-space diffusion models for whole-body humanoid locomotion and manipulation skills (ICRA 2026; IROS 2026).
Parallelized human-to-humanoid motion retargeting on GPUs and demonstrated scaling laws for skill transfer (ICRA 2026; IROS 2026).

work.name: Interactive 3D Vision & Learning Lab, Brown University
highlights: Developed cross-embodied motion-generation policies spanning human and quadruped embodiments (ICRA 2025; CoRL 2024 X-Embodiment Workshop).
Worked on sim-to-real reinforcement learning for whole-body humanoid control, including force- and terrain-aware motion tracking (ICRA 2026; IROS 2026; under review).

work.name: Robotics Research Center, IIIT Hyderabad
highlights: Developed FinderNet, a robust 6-DOF loop detection and closure system for point clouds (WACV 2024, Round 1 acceptance).
Developed real-time uncertainty-aware motion planning for quadrotors (ICRA 2022; ACC 2023).

work.name: Robotics Research Center, IIIT Hyderabad
highlights: Worked on plane-based visual-inertial odometry in highly dynamic environments (IROS 2021).

work.name: Summer Geometry Initiative, MIT
highlights: Implemented DeltaConv for anisotropic point-cloud convolutions and developed a fast surface triangulation algorithm for NeuralODF.
